name: Duplicate Identity / Ambiguous AD Accounts
diagnosis: Multiple Active Directory accounts share the same UPN or Email address. Cisco ISE cannot uniquely identify the user during 802.1X authentication.
recommended_actions: Identify conflicting accounts in Active Directory.
Verify if a secondary account (e.g. -admin, contractor, or test account) shares the same UPN/email.
Remove or update the duplicate 'mail' or 'userPrincipalName' attribute on the non-primary account.
